thread:
marta_cs: Heads-up — Acme (acct: acme-prod) is seeing repeated 504s on long streaming /v1/generate calls since ~03:00 UTC. They attached SDK logs and a couple request IDs: rc_9a1f2, rc_9a1f3. Payloads are ~150k chars, streaming chunked response.
sam_support: Thanks — can you drop the minimal repro and the SDK version? Also, did they use our hosted API or Dedicated?
acme_ops: Hosted API (us-west1). SDK: python 2.4.1. We observed client retries kicking in, roughly every 6-8s, ended up with 3 retries before success or final 504.
marta_cs: Sent repro curl + headers: 
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"rw/longstream","input":"<large payload>","stream":true}'
```
riju_eng-infra: Looking. Initial glance: 504s match gateway timeouts from edge proxies when backend stalls on large payload read/write. Can you confirm client keepalive/timeout config?
acme_ops: Default SDK timeouts. We didn't set keepalive.
kevin_platform: For streaming large responses we recommend increasing client read timeout and enabling HTTP/2 multiplexing with keepalive. But we need to repro without customer creds — can you provide sanitized request ids and a short test payload we can run?
marta_cs: Provided rc_9a1f2 logs and sanitized payload in the ticket. Also included HTTP trace (curl --trace).
sam_support: Reproduced locally using our instrumented agent — got a 504 after ~30s while server was flushing big chunk. Adding `--no-keepalive` on curl made behavior different.
riju_eng-infra: Interesting — edge logs show connection being evicted by our ingress LB due to long idle time while client wasn't reading/writing steady frames. There are also intermittent 502 spikes from a specific edge node (edge-7).
kevin_platform: Can you paste the small log snippet?
riju_eng-infra: Pasted: `ingress: conn_eviction reason=idle_timeout node=edge-7 backend=be-23 req=rc_9a1f2`. Followed by `proxy: upstream_reset before headers` and then gateway returns 504.
marta_cs: I relayed that to Acme — they're asking for a mitigation they can apply immediately.
sam_support: Temporary customer workaround: lower streaming chunk sizes (if possible) or set SDK read_timeout=120s and disable aggressive retries. Suggest they set exponential backoff with higher max interval.
acme_ops: We'll try read_timeout=120s and bump backoff to 30s max. Will report in ~30m.
kevin_platform: On our end: creating a short-term ingress patch to extend idle eviction threshold for streaming routes in us-west1 by +30s. Opening PR and will roll to canary on edge-7 first. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/ingress/pulls/4287 :shipit:
deploy-bot: deploy started for pr/4287 -> canary(edge-7). ETA ~10m.
riju_eng-infra: Also enabling additional logging on the edge-7 path to capture tcp keepalive and window events. If mitigation looks good we'll backfill config to the rest of us-west1 nodes.
marta_cs: Noted — relayed mitigation + SDK recommendations to customer. They asked for an ETA; can we share approximate window?
kevin_platform: If canary is clean in 30m we'll promote globally within 2hrs.
sam_support: Acme confirmed after applying SDK changes they saw fewer immediate 504s in initial test (1/10 failed). Waiting for longer run.
acme_ops: Update 20m later: after SDK timeout/backoff change, sustained run (50 requests) passed w/o 504. We'll keep running for 2 hours.
riju_eng-infra: Canary telemetry looks good — edge-7 showed drop in evictions. Promoting to remaining nodes now.
kevin_platform: Promotion started. I'll update ticket and CS with final roll completion.
marta_cs: Thanks team — I'll keep monitoring and will re-open if any regression. :thumbsup:
